page.notes: Hebrew forms in the left and right columns are copied as I read them; the vowel pointing on several forms (יִתְצְרֵהוּ, נִי, יִתְקְעוּ, יִתְרִים) is doubtful and not fully legible at this scan resolution. Top headers "י ת" on both columns are Hebrew letters, not a running title, and are left out. The bottom-left signature is C c 3; the Hebrew numeral כא is the page number. The left column's first line and the right column's first line are column-start fragments and are kept as such.
